agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
March 12, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Richard Velasquez, Olive Branch Calvary Chapel
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Girl Scout Troop 15424
4.
ROLL CALL
5.
PUBLIC COMMENT
6.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PROCLAMATION FOR AMERICAN RED CROSS AWARENESS MONTH - It is recommended the City Council proclaim March 2019 as American Red Cross Awareness Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to American Red Cross Volunteer Adriana Millan.
Proclamation - American Red Cross Awareness Month
6.2
INTRODUCTION OF NEW CITY EMPLOYEES - It is recommended the City Council welcome Jose Newman, Corina Ramirez and Andrew Navarro, and present them with a $40.00 gift certificate to Polly's Pie Restaurant, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.
6.2 Introduction of New City Employees
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
REAPPOINTMENT TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION AND SENIOR COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council reappoint Michael Lord to the La Mirada Community Foundation for a term expiring in May 2019 and reappoint Tom Rosholt to the Senior Council for a term expiring in June 2019.
7.1 Reappointments
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of February 26, 2019.
8.1 Minutes of February 26, 2019
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated March 12, 2019 in the total amount of $1,474,536.99.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING JANUARY 2018 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending January 2018.
8.3 Monthly Treasurer Report
8.4
RELEASE OF BONDS FOR TRACT NUMBER 73119, THE OLSON COMPANY, 12000 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD - It is recommended the City Council release the bonds in the amount of $1,042,502 to The Olson Company for Tract Number 73119.
8.4 Release of Bonds for Tract No. 73119
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-07 APPROVING THE ENTERTAINMENT PERMIT APPLICATION FOR SPORTSMAN'S LOUNGE LOCATED AT 13902 IMPERIAL HIGHWAY - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 19-07 approving the Entertainment Permit application of the Sportsman's Lounge located at 13902 Imperial Highway subject to the Conditions of Approval.
9.1 Public Hearing for Entertainment Permit
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-08 APPROVING THE INSTALLATION OF 40 FEET OF RED CURB ON THE NORTH SIDE OF ALICANTE ROAD EAST OF LAS PUERTAS STREET - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-08 approving the installation of 40 feet of red curb on the north side of Alicante Road east of Las Puertas Street.
10.1 Resolution No. 19-08
10.2
RESOLUTION NO. 19-09 ADOPTING A PROJECT LIST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019-20 FUNDED BY SB 1: THE ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-09 adopting a project list for Fiscal Year 2019-20 funded by SB-1; reallocate the Fiscal Year 2017-18 funds towards Measure I Residential Street Phase V; and authorize staff to submit the project list to the California Transportation Commission.
10.2 Resolution No. 19-09
HOUSING SUCCESSOR

11.1
RESOLUTION NO. HS19-01 AUTHORIZING A BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR THE BREEZEWOOD VILLAGE SENIOR HOUSING LIMITED PARTNERSHIP PAYMENT - It is recommended the City Council acting in its capacity as the Housing Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. HS19-01 authorizing a budget amendment for the Breezewood Village Senior Housing Limited Partnership payment.
11.1 Resolution No. HS19-01
